verdict.rationale: Sentry is a SaaS platform with AI features (Seer), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence pack contains no documented setting, policy, or guarantee that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Server-side data scrubbing, self-hosting and US/EU data storage location are adjacent privacy controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
